redeem.minimum_rule: min_output_raw equals amount_raw; no USDC deduction in this policy

sell.alternative: Existing separately approved Xeris wrap and sell, then redeem the exact chosen xUSDC amount

existing_envelopes: capabilities/quotes/challenges/requests/access/status retain service.py schema_version 1 envelopes and intent-v2 binding keys

endpoints.purpose: Original ownership proof restores status access even after expiry; no new funds accepted

source.expires_at: Unix integer seconds, bounded by intent and blockhash

endpoints.rule: Exact prepared message and source Ed25519 signature are independently verified. Original signed bytes and ID are durable before any broadcast. Identical retries return status; no automatic resend/replacement.

source_rules.buy: Existing source USDC ATA only, derived from source_owner. Six ordered accounts [owner,sourceATA,reserveATA,USDCmint,classicTokenProgram,MemoProgram]; header [1,0,3]; exact TransferChecked(index0,amount_raw,decimals6), then Memo(index1,accounts[0]) ASCII xeris:settlement:v2:<intent_digest>. User pays observed Solana fee; no source ATA creation or unrelated instruction.
source_rules.redeem: Exactly one Xeris TokenBurn(xeris_usdc,source_owner,amount_raw), one source-owner signature; 0.001 native XRS gas. Burn does not encode recipient: prior signed intent plus exact prepared message/global claim binding is mandatory. Destination is the fixed USDC ATA derived from destination_owner; payout may create it idempotently at operator expense.
source_rules.recipient: buy destination_owner is Xeris recipient; redeem destination_owner is Solana recipient. Public address format is not ownership proof. Source proof signs all immutable economic/network/recipient fields.

recovery: Persist intent/proof/client_request_id and original signed source transaction locally BEFORE HTTP submit. After timeout restore/query same request; never create a replacement request, signature or burn. Completion requires verified delivery/payout, not submission acknowledgment. Pausing never hides known obligations or disables their observation.
amounts: All raw monetary amounts are canonical decimal strings, u64 bounded. Timestamps are exact Unix integer seconds. Quotes expire in 60 seconds; a valid on-chain event may finalize later but must meet its bound source acceptance window.
chain_trust: Finalized Solana receipts; pinned, agreeing Xeris observers with complete canonical block evidence and explicit confirmation depth. This is operator-mediated settlement, not a trustless bridge or irreversible-finality proof.

status_output_fields.actual_output_raw: null until confirmed completed; exact deliver/payout raw amount thereafter
status_output_fields.refund_amount_raw: null until confirmed refunded; exact Solana USDC raw amount thereafter
status_output_fields.refund_asset: null unless confirmed refunded, then solana_usdc

expired_original_recovery: POST submit-source at or after intent/prepared expiry is guaranteed observation-only and never broadcasts. Exact already committed original always returns status without resend. A newly reported original is matched to retained prepared bytes, verified, persisted as recovery-only and observed. Local clients with a signed source must not replace a server-cancelled request.
